title: "Flipped learning" methodology in professional training of future language teachers
reason: Flipped-classroom experiment (EG/CG): language proficiency compared between groups; correlations link self-reported readiness, motivation and perceived learning only. No platform-recorded measure enters any analysis.

extraction.n_quote: Two groups of students were formed to participate in this experiment (with the total number of 61students)
extraction.population: second-year language and literature teaching students, Khmelnytskyi Humanitarian-Pedagogical Academy
extraction.outcome_or_construct: language proficiency; self-reported learning readiness, academic motivation, perceived learning, learning preferences
extraction.notes: Secondary NOREL: r = .41-.69 among self-report scales only (paper prints 'p> .05' with '**p< .01' in the table).
